prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Phoenix for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” Phoenix car-accident lawyer—the right choice depends on injury severity, insurance coverage, fault disputes, and whether the case may need trial.

For a serious injury or disputed-liability case, prioritize a Phoenix attorney who:

- Focuses primarily on personal-injury and auto-collision litigation  
- Has recent jury-trial experience, not just settlement volume  
- Personally handles your case rather than passing it immediately to a case manager  
- Has experience with your injury type (TBI, spinal injury, surgery, wrongful death, etc.)  
- Works on contingency and clearly explains the percentage, litigation costs, and what happens if you lose  
- Has no meaningful Arizona State Bar disciplinary history  

Well-known Phoenix-area personal-injury firms you can compare include Lerner & Rowe, Goldberg & Osborne, Zanes Law, The Husband & Wife Law Team, and Breyer Law Offices. Being well known does not necessarily mean they are the best fit for your particular case, so schedule free consultations with two or three firms.

Questions to ask each lawyer:
1. “Will you personally be my attorney, and who will handle day-to-day communication?”  
2. “How many car-accident cases like mine have you taken to trial?”  
3. “What is your contingency fee, and are case costs deducted before or after the fee?”  
4. “What issues could reduce the value of my claim?”  
5. “Do you foresee filing a lawsuit, and on what timeline?”  

You can verify a lawyer’s license and disciplinary record through the State Bar of Arizona’s attorney directory. Also, avoid signing immediately after an unsolicited call, text, or hospital visit—Arizona restricts improper solicitation, and reputable firms should give you time to review the agreement.
